name: door-attended
description: Does a door patch ENTER when the player uses the door? The last selector never observed running.

_comment: A fourth patch, door:he1_01:9:interact, was here as an out-of-range
control. he1_01 has exactly ONE door (D137), so it addressed nothing and
nobody could tell -- it reported NO_SCRIPT at run time and looked like a
control that had simply not fired. `bleck doors` now catalogues every
map's doors and the build refuses such a selector outright (D141),
